mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT g.id FROM nw_group_bindings g JOIN nw_group_memberships m ON (m.tenant_id,m.integration_id,m.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_group_service_agents a ON (a.tenant_id,a.integration_id,a.group_binding_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.id) JOIN nw_integration_business_scopes b ON (b.tenant_id,b.integration_id,b.scope_id)=(g.tenant_id,g.integration_id,g.business_scope_id) JOIN nw_end_users e ON e.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND e.external_integration_id=g.integration_id AND e.id=m.end_user_id JOIN nw_service_principals p ON p.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND p.integration_id=g.integration_id JOIN nw_tenants n ON n.id=g.tenant_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.id=#{group} AND g.status='active' AND m.end_user_id=#{user} AND m.status='active' AND a.agent_id=#{agent} AND a.status='active' AND b.status='active' AND e.status='active' AND n.status IN('active','warning') AND p.principal_id=#{principal} AND p.credential_version=#{credential} AND p.status='active' AND p.scopes @> '["groups.memory.write"]'::jsonb FOR SHARE OF g,m,a,b,e,p,n) current_qualification)
